description: This file defines the EmailConfig class, which manages email configuration settings such as host, port, protocol, authentication, and TLS options. It includes methods for serializing the configuration to JSON and getters/setters for its fields.

classes.name: EmailConfig
classes.description: A class representing email server configuration parameters, capable of serializing itself to a JSON string.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the email configuration data into a JSON-formatted string.

methods.name: isSmtpAuth
methods.description: Returns whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the email templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Gets the path to the email templates.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username used for authentication.
